name: Robotopia Chronos
author: QuantumWorks
description: Framework SDK service that controls GAME TIME — the single, leak-proof authority over Unity's timeScale/fixedDeltaTime. A reusable foundation for time-bending gamemodes: a hard freeze (turn-based / RPG pause / freeze-to-talk), a continuous or input-driven scale (Superhot 'time moves only when you move', with the player kept full-speed), bounded stepping, and a full turn scheduler. Effects are ref-counted owner-tagged leases force-reset on every teardown, so a held scale can never leak into a menu or the next gamemode.
